trust_decision.summary: Local-account password authentication: the stored credential is an unsalted MD5 hex digest produced by MD5Encrypt and checked by plain string equality on login; the decision is made in AuthService.Login and the stored value is written by InitOwner, Register and UpdateUser.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names crypto.go MD5Encrypt directly; an engineer would open the helper first, then follow its callers.

fix_sites.entry_point: helper used by all routes below (public package function MD5Encrypt)

fix_sites.module_kind: schema / persistence model (user_local_auth table, PasswordAlgo default md5, never written at pinned commit)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: internal/model/user/auth_identity.go:12-17 (user_local_auth table with PasswordAlgo default md5, migrated at internal/database/database.go:142 but never written); stored MD5 hashes also travel in snapshot zips of data/ech0.db (internal/migrator/snapshot/writer.go:8)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The pre-existing user_local_auth schema and snapshot/restore data are 'storage/migration concerns', not the hashing bug; a solver can swap MD5 for bcrypt in the service layer and argue legacy rows and the unused table are out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Existing accounts whose users.password holds a legacy MD5 hex digest (all accounts created before the fix, and those in restored snapshots) must still be able to log in; a naive swap to bcrypt-only verification locks every existing user out, and swapping the hash at write sites without changing the equality compare breaks all logins.

O6_input_shapes: login password against stored hash (legacy MD5 or new)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a migrateUsers step copying users.password hashes from a source ech0.db into the live DB
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The ech0 importer already opens the source sqlite and migrates echos, tags, files and comments (importer.go:159,201,284,402); importing accounts is a natural next step and would carry MD5 hashes in unchanged.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an owner-only admin reset-password action next to UpdateUserAdmin that sets user.Password via its own hashing call
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: UpdateUserAdmin already lets the owner modify another user's record; a reset-password feature beside it is a common admin need and would be written in a second file/function away from Login.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second credential lookup/verify helper in the auth repository that compares a precomputed hash
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The auth repository already has its own GetUserByUsername separate from the user repository (internal/repository/user/user.go:38), so a parallel verify path is plausible.

O9_family: Weak password hashing (unsalted MD5 for stored credentials; CWE-327/CWE-310)
